items: STAY INFORMED WITHOUT UNLOCKING – Stay updated without waking your main screen. The innovative 1.6" rear Vista Display gives you instant alerts without the need to open or unlock the primary display, making this the ideal smart phone for busy professionals on the move.

YOUR POCKET-SIZED ENTERTAINMENT POWERHOUSE - Immerse yourself in the action. From live NFL Sundays to blockbuster movies, the stunning 6.7" FHD+ AMOLED screen and buttery-smooth 120Hz refresh rate ,8GB RAM, 256GB storagetransform this Cell Phone into a premium theater right in the palm of your hands.

ULTIMATE FREEDOM WITH TRUE DUAL SIM - Travel smart and easily separate work from play. Standing out among unlocked phones, this 5G device is ready out-of-the-box for major US carriers like T-Mobile, Mint, and Metro, giving you the ultimate flexibility to choose the best network for your lifestyle.

CAPTURE LIFE'S BEST MOMENTS LIKE A PRO - Elevate your social media game effortlessly. The AI-enhanced 64MP rear camera and 16MP front lens automatically adapt to any lighting condition, ensuring your photos and videos always look crisp, vibrant, and ready to share, setting a new standard for mobile phones.

RELIABLE ENERGY FOR YOUR BUSY LIFESTYLE - Leave your charger at home with confidence. Powered by a massive 5000mAh battery and the ultra-efficient Android 15 OS, this android phone delivers reliable, continuous energy that easily keeps up with your longest commutes and most demanding schedules.
